name: Masayoshi Tomizuka
title: Cheryl and John Neerhout, Jr. Distinguished Professor; Distinguished Professor of Mechanical Engineering
fitReason: Direct overlap between learned robot policies and physical control, with current group projects in closed-loop foundation-model adaptation, whole-body humanoid navigation and dexterous manipulation.

physicalEvidence.summary: CLIFT (July2026) reports learned closed-loop policy improvement on a real Unitree G1 for box packing, cup insertion and bimanual plate transfer. TANGO (September2026) reports real G1 whole-body navigation using a VLA trained in simulation. Both are listed on the current MSC research page, and the current group roster identifies project leader Yuxin Chen as a lab PhD student; these are current-group deployments with collaborators, not inferred robot ownership.

shortVisit.summary: The current MSC homepage expressly invites people seeking visiting opportunities to email Tomizuka or the relevant project contact with a CV and short research statement, separate from its Berkeley-enrolled undergraduate/master's language. A July14,2025 soft-robotics call for undergraduate or visiting students remains posted, and the current research page welcomes prospective visitors in that project. Neither establishes a 2027 opening or eight-week acceptance.

scoreReasons.fit: Current generalist robot policies, VLA navigation and adaptive physical control closely match AI plus real-robot methods.
scoreReasons.physical: Two named 2026 G1 hardware studies connected by current official research links and current group student roster.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Explicit general visiting inquiry route, with no supported eight-week period or external-master's-specific invitation.
scoreReasons.freshness: July and September2026 primary technical papers plus current faculty and lab pages.
